pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"Most states don't license piano tuning or repair. Some register repair businesses, and some cities want a business license: the state's or city's form says. Safe default: the business registration on file, shown on the listing.","who it's held by":"The company, where the state or city asks. A tuner holds no license of their own for tuning. A voluntary certificate (an RPT from a piano technicians' guild) is proof of training, not a license.","what to ask":["The company's business registration or license number, where the state's or city's form asks for one","A tuner's training certificate (an RPT, for example), if the owner wants it shown on the listing","General liability insurance (a tuner works in customers' homes and around heavy instruments)"],"how it's checked":"none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie","blocks going live":"Where the state or city requires a registration, the listing goes live once it's set up. Otherwise the business registration only.","renewals":"Reminders before a license, registration or insurance date; a lapse pauses new bookings","background checks":"Only where the state's form asks","at the studio":"A small piano studio with pianos to try: the state's or city's form says if it needs a registration. Safe default: the business registration on file."}

pluginText.pf.questions: {"before times (they set the price, length or who can go)":["What kind of piano: an upright, a spinet, a grand or a baby grand? Acoustic only (digital pianos are not tuned)","The brand, and about how old it is","When was it last tuned? (more than a year can mean a pitch raise)","Was it moved lately? (a moved piano needs about 2 weeks to settle)","Is anything wrong: sticking keys, a buzz, a broken string?"],"after a time is picked":["Who will be home: the customer, or another adult (their name and mobile go on the secure page)","Is the piano in a quiet room, away from a heater, a vent or a sunny window?","Pets, children and parking","Own or rent, and who pays: the customer, a school, or a landlord"],"only on the secure page":["The street address","A photo of the piano's nameboard and the plate inside (brand and serial)","Gate or lock codes","The organization's contact, for a venue","The card"],"who may book":"An adult. A renter books, and the owner OKs it where they pay. A school, church or hall books as an organization and names who meets the tuner.","studio":["Which pianos the customer wants to try, and their budget (optional)","At the studio's bench: which part, and what it is doing"]}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stops the booking":[{"words":"A piano that tipped over or fell, or anyone hurt or pinned by one","says":"Get everyone away from the piano, and call 911 now if anyone is hurt or trapped. Don't try to lift it.","booking":"No booking until everyone is safe; the customer can come back."},{"words":"Smoke, flames, sparks or a burning smell from the piano's humidity heater, a lamp or an outlet; or a gas smell","says":"Get everyone out now. Once outside, call 911. Don't go back in.","booking":"No booking until it's safe."}],"safety steps, then the booking goes on, marked urgent":[{"words":"A string snapped with a bang, or a loose wire sticking out","says":"Close the lid and keep children and pets away. Don't touch the wire: it can cut and spring back.","booking":"Goes on, marked urgent; the soonest tuning or repair time is offered first."},{"words":"Water spilled or flooded onto the piano or under it","says":"Keep away from wet outlets and cords. Don't play it. Unplug a humidity system only if the outlet is dry.","booking":"Goes on, marked urgent."},{"words":"The piano is leaning, a leg is cracked, or it rocks","says":"Don't lean on it or let children climb on it. Keep people out from in front of it.","booking":"Goes on, marked urgent."}],"business_line":"Questions about whether a piano is safe to play or to move go to the business's own line","never":"Customers are told never to tighten a string or open the piano themselves, and never to let a child climb on an upright"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"at the start of the visit":"A pitch check with the tuning device, before the price and the work: passed, the tuning goes ahead; flat by more than a quarter tone, a pitch raise is priced first and needs the customer's yes; a piano that can't hold a tuning (cracked pinblock, loose pins) stops there with a written note","before the first visit":"A piano moved in the last 2 weeks needs about 2 weeks to settle before a tuning, so the first open times start after that. The tuner asks when it was moved.","after the quote":["A written contract above the plug-in's amount, signed before a regulation starts","A humidity system: a free outlet near the piano, checked from the photos"],"prep":["Clear a path to the piano and keep the room quiet during the visit: no vacuum, TV or music","Keep the piano away from heat, a vent or a sunny window for a day before, and don't set drinks or plants on it","Keep children and pets away from the piano while the tuner works"],"studio prep":["Bring a list of pianos you've seen, if any","At the bench, bring the part and its screws"]}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"At the home: the check-in code at the door, with an adult home for the whole visit. At the studio: the code at the counter.","at_the_visit":"The tuner checks the pitch, then tunes every string. The piano is left playable. A sticking key, a squeak or a broken string is shown and priced before it is fixed.","changes":"A pitch raise, a broken string or a sticking key found at the visit is priced first and needs the customer's yes. Work done is billed; work declined is not.","done":"The tuner plays the piano through with the customer, notes the pitch, then DONE","studio done":"DONE after the consult, or READY when a part is fixed and waiting at the counter","before photos":"The piano's front, its nameboard and plate, and any damage the customer pointed out"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"tuning":"A tuning is a list price; a repair is quoted at the visit, and only the $89 visit is promised. The $89 is the late-cancel and no-show fee, and counts toward a repair.","pitch raise":"A pitch raise is priced at the visit and added only after the customer's yes; the second tuning is booked at the list price.","yearly plan":"A yearly tuning is $150 a visit, paid in full when booked; each visit is booked and paid like a single one.","deposit":"A humidity system takes a 25% deposit after the quote is OK'd; a regulation takes a deposit only after the contract is signed. The deposit cap comes from the state's form.","balance":"The rest on the bill after the visit, or at the last stage; never ahead of the work","rosfield_fee":"Rosfield's $2 follows the plug-in's choice at sign-up; counted at the first check-in","big_bills":"Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check or cash also works: the tuner texts 'paid check' or 'paid cash'.","tips":"No tip line","tax":"Tax on parts and labor follows the state's form","studio":"A buying consult's $35 is the studio's; a video check is paid in full when booked; a $20 fee on a consult or a bench check only after Sam OKs it"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_texts":["Gate or lock codes","The street address (the secure page has it)","Contract and change-order papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)"],"languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"Never booked by a minor; a child at home never lets the tuner in, and is kept away from the piano"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"Tuners and technicians (Anton, Mei): tunings, repairs and installs. Studio techs (Luca, Joan): the consults and the bench.","licenses":"None for tuning. A training certificate is shown as given if the owner lists it.","who_oks":"Sam OKs quotes over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins","stand_in":"Another tuner may take a tuning; a regulation keeps its technician unless Sam moves it","on_call":"None: every job is booked ahead","lifting":"A grand's lid, action or leg work needs two people; the tuner never lifts a piano alone"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written contract above the plug-in's amount (the example: $500) for a regulation or an install, signed before work starts","pitch":"A pitch raise and any repair found at the visit needs the customer's yes first, with its price","guarantee":"A 30-day touch-up on a tuning: notes that drift get a free fix, except after a pitch raise or a big humidity swing (the example's)","repair_warranty":"90 days on repairs (the example's)","records":"The piano's make, serial and last pitch are kept for the next visit; 7 years","cancel":"A change inside 24 hours may owe the $89 fee, only if a card was saved and Sam says yes","moving":"The business does not move pianos; it says so plainly and points to the kind of business that does"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"A big swing in humidity or heat just before the visit: the tuner may advise a later time; a weather move never costs the customer","too_flat":"A piano flat by more than a quarter tone: a pitch raise first, priced at the visit, then a second tuning in 2 to 4 weeks","cannot_hold":"A cracked pinblock or soundboard, or loose pins: the tuner says so, tunes as far as is safe, and quotes the repair; only what was done is billed","just_moved":"A piano moved in the last 2 weeks waits to settle; the AI offers times after that","digital":"A digital piano or keyboard is not offered; the AI says so plainly","pests":"A mouse nest or moths in the felts: the tuner stops that part, the customer gets a written note, and pest control comes first","venue":"A recital or venue tuning is booked by the organization at a set time, with a contact who opens the room","nobody_home":"Never; an adult is home for the whole visit","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
